reference: Original 02 — The Veiled Threshold, selected by the user
cardBack:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Refine this specific Olivia Arcana tarot CARD BACK. The attached image is the user's selected direction, "The Veiled Threshold". Preserve its identity and layout: two opposed Roman archways form one long oval portal, slender lapis columns at both sides, parted carved ivory curtains at top and bottom, two very quiet olive garlands crowning the top and bottom arcs, a generous empty midnight-blue opening. Full-bleed portrait 7:12, one complete card, front-on and unwarped. Not a new scene, not a collage.

The refinement should feel like a commissioned piece of neoclassical intaglio and ivory inlay, made by a skilled ornamental artist. Make both halves deliberately correspond through a 180-degree turn. The folds, column joints, olive placement and frame geometry must be balanced through a half-turn. Retain the opening's beautiful long oval silhouette, but slightly slim and clarify the architecture. Reduce the bulky centre column plinths to quieter low-profile carved bands, keeping the same physical connection. Use precise sculpted acanthus capitals, fine deep-blue leaf carving, hairline pale gold inlay just inside each arch. Carved ivory veils have beautiful coherent fabric anatomy: folds originate at the arch, gather at the two side ties, then taper elegantly beside the columns. They look finely cut and supple, not thick stone slabs or melted wax. Refined shallow relief, delicate bevels and readable microcarving.

Material finish: deeper cleaner midnight lapis with subtle mineral variation, antique warm ivory, tiny restrained champagne-gold olives. Replace the coarse scratches, heavy cracking and scattered gold speckling with quiet believable finely polished stone. Keep only the smallest occasional mineral flecks. No astronomical star field. Consistent restrained relief lighting with delicate contact shadows; no big outside cast shadow. Let the vivid but muted blue stone support the luminous ivory folds. Corners rounded neatly, slim dark rim all around. No thick gold rectangular frame or shiny bevel.

Important: central oval opening remains unoccupied and quietly dark. NO pasted symbol, no words, no text, no medallion, no eyes, no moon, no figures, no landscape, no hidden scene. The architecture IS the ornament of the card back. Preserve that intended silence. The two-ended composition should unmistakeably be the reverse of a deck, belonging to an Olivia Arcana identity based on the arch and veil. Exceptional subtle craftsmanship rather than extra decoration.
sculpturalEmblem:
Use case: sketch-to-render. A sculptural interpretation of the new Olivia Arcana logo. Create one square image with the emblem front-facing, centered on quiet deep midnight lapis blue, generous clear space.

Input 1 is the exact native-vector logo geometry. Preserve its outline, proportions, open bottom, arch thickness and two graceful tapering inner veils closely. The outside is one thin round-topped arch with straight legs. Inside are two long tapering curved veil shapes, beginning narrowly high beneath the arch, gathering at the sides and trailing down in fine curved tails. Do NOT add columns, a sill, capitals, ties, symbols, lettering or other detail that changes the silhouette.
Input 2 is material reference only. Borrow its warm ivory carving, blue lapis and fine antique gold inlay, not its busy architecture, olive garlands or full card frame.

Render the arch as slender satin lapis with one hairline pale champagne-gold inner inlay, distinct against the deeper blue ground. Render the two veil shapes as warm ivory: extremely beautiful coherent shallow drapery relief with only two or three long incised folds within each shape. The folds visibly taper, with fine clean edges and subtle lifted tips. No heavy texture, weathering, marble cracks, grainy gold or plastic. A small amount of believable carving and softness in the fabric, not melted wax. Gentle contact shadows and precise bevels produce real depth while the mark stays graphic and readable.

Atmosphere: contemplative, luminous ivory against deep lapis, the centre deliberately empty and silent. There is no scene behind the opening; that emptiness is part of the logo. Restrained even product-art light. The emblem occupies about 75 percent of image height. Simple dark background, no perspective, no outside drop shadow, no glowing void, no star field, no painting scene. No text, watermark, labels or mockup. The result should feel like a tiny finely made inlaid seal photographed straight on, not a theatre stage.
